text:
Situation: Metoclopramide hydrochloride 15 mg/0.07 mL 9.8 mL bottle (NDC 72089030715) is short at Corvale East with 44 units on hand and 4.9 days of supply at 8.9 units per day. Corvale General holds 256.72 units with 29.2 days of supply at 8.8 units per day.

Why (FDA record): The SPL set 95269b1f lists five registered plants: ACM Pharma (France), COSMA S.p.A. (Italy), Intertek (UK), Patheon France SAS (France), and SGS France (France). FDA inspection records show only Voluntary Action Indicated classifications: ACM Pharma on 2024-01-24, COSMA S.p.A. on 2022-06-17, Intertek on 2023-06-30, Patheon France SAS on 2023-09-29, and SGS France on 2024-01-19. No Official Action Indicated classifications, warning letters, or import alerts appear for any facility. The drug is not listed on the FDA drug shortage database as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is critically low while Corvale General has adequate inventory. No FDA enforcement action explains the shortage. Manufacturer allocation status and any recent supply interruptions for this NDC must be confirmed with Evoke Pharma, Inc.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 82 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — Corvale General retains approximately two weeks of supply; Corvale East reaches approximately 14 days. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Contact Evoke Pharma, Inc. to verify current allocation status and confirm whether any recent supply interruptions have been reported for NDC 72089030715. Approval: Pharmacy Buyer.
3. Monitor daily usage at both sites and adjust par levels accordingly. Approval: Pharmacy Manager.

Not recommended: Initiate therapeutic alternatives or protocol changes without P&T Committee clinical review.
